name: PullMD
description: Anything in, clean Markdown out. Web pages, documents and YouTube to Markdown for people and AI agents.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The conversion cache and share links, accounts, API keys and the admin password.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: PullMD web app, REST API and MCP server, published on host as 6132

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open PullMD at, like http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6132 (for example http://192.168.1.20:6132), or your own https:// domain. PullMD works from any address without it. It is used for the links on the help page, the Claude skill download and OAuth sign-in for claude.ai. Keep the port at 6132.

variables.name: PULLMD_AUTH_MODE
variables.description: Who can use PullMD. disabled = anyone who can reach it, no sign-in. single-admin = only you, with the admin email and password. multi-user = people make their own accounts.

variables.name: PULLMD_ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: The email for the first admin account, used when sign-in is on. Put your own email here. Left blank, it is admin@example.com.

variables.name: PULLMD_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for the first admin account, used when sign-in is on. Leave it blank and the app makes a random one on first start. It is shown in the app log and saved in the data folder. Or type your own (at least 8 characters).
